en: Black-and-white image showing a quiet residential street lined with early 20th‑century houses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. In the foreground, two children stand on the sidewalk, while another person rides a bicycle down the unpaved or partially paved street. The houses have small front gardens with brick fences. On the right side, the gable wall of a corner house bears a large painted business sign reading "Albert Pusch. Maurermeister". The sky is blank/overexposed and the upper-right corner of the card is slightly torn.
